review_type: Single-agent qualitative review, not independent human validation
selection: Seed-490 stratified audit: first 40 are 20 credited and 20 uncredited B1/B2 responses; 15 targeted B3/B4/B5 cases.
limitations: Small targeted sample, no population precision/recall estimate. Judgments concern visible calculations/context only. Numeric reference equality is not a semantic proof.
